title: Rework FileNode/copy to deep-copy subtrees per filenode-20
description: 566c2b6/686e240/020da7f, draft lines 612-664: copying a Directory copies its subtree atomically; blobs are copied into the destination account; created/modified/accessed kept unless overridden; shareWith, role, isSubscribed not copied; source needs mayRead; implicit destroy for onSuccessDestroyOriginal uses onDestroyRemoveChildren=true. Crate: copies one node (crate-jmap-filenode-server filenode.rs:1826), rejects blobs absent from destination (:1749-1768), drops timestamp overrides (:1719, :2201), copies shareWith/role (merge_filenode_overrides :2186; memory.rs:1003), implicit destroy follows client flag (:2048-2120), depth check ignores subtree height (:1826).
